lines: My wife and I are residents of the Lakeview Senior Apartment Complex.
Some of the residents here have asked us to help them to get around town more easily.
The closest bus stop is half a mile below the apartment complex, down a steep hill.
Very few of the residents here feel comfortable walking all the way to (and especially from) the bus stop.
If the route for bus 15 could be changed to come up the hill to the complex, we would be thankful for it.
I can promise you that there will be several very grateful riders each day in each direction.
I look forward to hearing from you soon.
body.text: To Whom It May Concern: My wife and I are residents of the Lakeview Senior Apartment Complex. Some of the residents here have asked us to help them to get around town more easily. The closest bus stop is half a mile below the apartment complex, down a steep hill. Very few of the residents here feel comfortable walking all the way to (and especially from) the bus stop. If the route for bus 15 could be changed to come up the hill to the complex, we would be thankful for it. I can promise you that there will be several very grateful riders each day in each direction. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Sincerely, Ron Miller.
